$comment: Speaker -> voice. provider: 'elevenlabs' (voiceId), 'hf-space' (voicePrompt for voice design, or voiceId) or 'moss' (local MOSS-TTS-v1.5: reference = WAV file name inside KQ_MOSS_VOICES, default ~/kq-models/voices; seed; language; instruction; params). model per speaker overrides --model / the provider default (null = default). licence per provider (or per speaker) goes into each manifest entry: 'elevenlabs-free-noncommercial' | 'elevenlabs-paid' | 'apache-2.0-model'. voiceSettings = ElevenLabs voice_settings per speaker. postprocess.maxPauseSec (any provider) caps internal pauses. moss voiceId = moss:<speaker>:<sha8 of reference>:<seed>, so a new reference or seed regenerates. PLACEHOLDER voices (and moss speakers whose reference file is missing) are planned in --dry-run and skipped in a real run. Speakers not listed keep the murmur.
